english.title: Refuse to give name and address to authorised person / occupier of land
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having been found on land, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LAND..), in the daytime, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TIME..), in search or pursuit of game or woodcocks, snipes, or conies, and having been required forthwith to quit the land, failed to provide your name, address, date of birth and to quit land, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LAND..), when so requested by

(A)_[a person having the right of killing game upon such land,]_
(B)_[the occupier of the land,]_
(C)_[a gamekeeper, servant or other authorised person,]_

(D)_[he]_
(E)_[she]_

being a person lawfully entitled to make such a request under the provisions of section 31 of the Game Act 1831
english.legislation: Contrary to section 31 of the Game Act 1831.
